title: Job 66353 killed OUT_OF_MEMORY on r5n3
summary: Real M100 job 66353 on r5n3 was terminated by the kernel OOM killer; SLURM classified it OUT_OF_MEMORY. ganglia mem_free on r5n3 fell from ~260 GB to under ~10 GB (mem_total ~314 GB) before the kill, and total_power then dropped to idle.

timeline.event: mem_free on r5n3 begins steep decline
Snapshot captured — r5n3 at idle power

notes: Advise the user to reduce per-task memory or request a high-memory node.
